completed: THE ENHANCE DEAD-BOX IS FIXED. `MpiInput` had NO programmatic-write API at all - `setup` attached no methods - while every Primitive that gets driven from outside has one (MpiRadioGroup.setValue, MpiCheckbox.setChecked, MpiButton.setLabel/setActive/setIcon/setDisabled, MpiTileSheet.setSelected, MpiColorPicker.setHex). That absence is WHY seven other modules reach past it for `.mpi-input__field` by hand at eleven sites, and why an eighth caller could reach the mount HOST div instead and vanish silently. Added `el.setValue` (emits nothing - a programmatic write is not user input) and pointed `_writeFieldValue` at `qs('.mpi-input', wrap)?.setValue?.(text)`. `_liveFields` never needed to change. Fixes the empty phrase box AND clear-on-edit in one line.

TOGGLES ARE ICON+LABEL MpiButtons - the `toggle` TYPE itself, so one on/off vocabulary. Caption on the button face only; icon OPTIONAL (tick fallback). Turbo -> `bolt`, Headless front body -> `eraser`. Icon MODE is forced, not preferred: MpiButton's text mode ignores `toggleable` outright and every `is-active` rule in MpiButton.css is scoped to `.mpi-ibtn`. Widening that gate was TRIED AND REVERTED - it would have let an icon-less toggle flip a class that paints nothing.

THE LoRA PANEL. Fabio corrected my proposal mid-session and it made the job a third the size: he meant open the app's WHOLE Model Settings panel, NOT extract its rack. `settingsModel: 'krea2'` on the FlowDef + an `{ id:'loras', type:'button', action:'settings' }` field; MpiBaseFlow emits `ui:open-model-settings` and the owning Block opens its own overlay. BOTH Blocks wired - each mounts its own. No `lora` field type, no extraction.

AND THE HALF THAT MADE THE LoRA BUTTON MORE THAN DECORATION: a flow dispatches with `model.id: null` and commandExecutor gated LoRA injection on `payload.modelId`, so EVERY FLOW INJECTED ZERO LoRAs. The panel would have opened, saved real slots, and produced an identical image. `loraModelId` now crosses flowService -> the `runCommand` WHITELIST -> `params.Lora_N` -> `Input_Lora_N`, gated on the explicit id so no other universal op changes. Opt-in per flow. Reverses the 'RUN CLEAN, no project LoRAs' comment, which Fabio had already reversed in session 7.

VERIFIED: npm test 646/646, npm run test:desktop 21/21, eslint 0 errors, release:check passed, board validates clean, overtaken-cards 0. Four new test files. The two specs covering a SILENT failure were MUTATION-TESTED - put the old host-div write back, or cut the toggle onChange, and each goes red.

DOCS: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/lora-rack.md (new, indexed + linked from 01-descriptor-and-ops.md), the MpiInput setValue contract in docs/component-contracts.md, the flow-overlay spec traps in docs/testing.md, the `ui:open-model-settings` row in docs/events.md, and BOTH Block entries in .claude/rules/component-events-blocks.md (Fabio approved that rule edit explicitly).
CLAIM AUDITOR RAN: 17 claims proven, 3 flagged, all three fixed - see `## Plan Drift` and validation.md. One was genuinely FALSE and had been copied into three files.

COMMIT LANDED: f28825ee, 33 files, hook PASSED with no --no-verify. The blocker was MPI-582 adding `mpi/no-bare-form-control` without clearing MpiBaseFlow.js, so any commit touching that file was rejected on four warnings that predate this work. Fixed at the root as Fabio asked: the back link, both carousel arrows, the ticker tick and the slot clear are ghost MpiButtons, mounted via a local `_mountButton` helper rather than written into the `template:` string. The ids move onto the mounted <button> itself - a click on a mount HOST div does nothing, and #flow-prev / #flow-next are what three desktop specs drive. Their stylesheets shrank to geometry and typography; the four deliberate overrides (the arrow LEAVES rather than greying out, the ticker keeps its own hover wash, a tick is a label so it is not uppercased, the slot clear keeps its scrim) are scoped past the Primitive's own selectors rather than relying on stylesheet order. Verified: eslint 0 warnings on all 10 committed js files at --max-warnings=0, npm test 646/646, test:desktop 21/21 (including the three specs that click the arrows), release:check, and a pixel probe on a real renderer - all four read back as BUTTON, back icon still 12px, tick lowercase at weight 400, disabled arrow at opacity 0 with no grayscale filter. The inherited 1px border and mono face are inert: box-sizing is border-box globally and body was already JetBrains Mono.

key_decisions: REUSE THE WHOLE SURFACE, DO NOT EXTRACT A PIECE OF IT. Fabio's correction this session, and it generalises: 'the same panel as the models have, which has everything already built in.' I had proposed extracting MpiModelSettings' LoRA rack into a shared Compound. Wrong, and three times the work. Written up as memory feedback_open_the_existing_surface_whole.

A FLOW'S LoRAs ARE THE MODEL'S OWN SETTINGS, shared with its ordinary generations - a LoRA loaded for krea2 is the same LoRA whether the sheet or the prompt box runs it. That is what made this need no new persistence. 'Perhaps add a new route for flow LoRAs' was Fabio's own tentative aside and was NOT built; it only becomes a question if he wants flow LoRAs isolated from the model's.

NO RELEASE NOTE IS OWED and this was checked, not assumed: v1.4.2 is released so its notes are frozen, but the Flow Library is dev-gated, `action: enhance` exists only on character-sheet, and both toggles plus the `settingsModel` opt-in are character-sheet-only. Nothing here is perceivable in a build a user can install.
STAGED-LoRA MODELS ARE REFUSED, NOT GUESSED. A `loraStages` model needs its stage prefixes; the injection warns and skips rather than writing flat slots into a staged graph.
